Lead.description:
One lead surfaced by a survey.

The shape is the discovery lead minus the envelope `source` key,
which the orchestrator stamps. Doubles as the item shape of the
generated `survey` judgment-answer schema.

lead.description:
Stable kebab-case lead identifier, unique only within its
source; identity is the `(source, lead)` pair.

topics.description:
Agent-authored per-lead topic slugs (kebab-case). Empty means
unclassified.

description: Generated judgment-answer schema — generated from the Rust wire types by project::answers; do not edit. Validates the schema-gated answer to a source adapter's survey operation: an object carrying `leads[]`, each item the lead shape minus the envelope `source` key (the caller attributes every lead to the surveyed source). Lead ids and topic slugs carry the kebab-case grammar in-schema and are re-checked deterministically after the gate, alongside the trim-aware synopsis check the schema cannot express.

leads.description: Every lead the survey surfaced, in source order.

title: Specify survey answer
